interaction.prompt: After a dump-in their defender is bobbling the puck on the boards with their head down. Tap where you should pinch down to close on them under control.

mc.stem: You are the forechecking winger. Their defender is bobbling the puck on the boards with their head down. What should you do?
opts: Pinch down under control along the boards to close the gap and trap them
Back out to the neutral zone and give them time to settle the puck
Drift to the middle of the blue line and tap your stick for a pass
Leave the strong side and skate all the way to the far boards

feedback.right: Yes. Gap control is not only for defensemen. When an opponent bobbles the puck, close quickly and under control before they recover.
feedback.wrong: Backing off or drifting hands a bobbling opponent the time they need to recover. Pinch down the boards under control and close the gap.

tip: When an opponent fumbles the puck, close the gap fast and under control before they recover.
why: Gap control applies to forwards too. Closing on a bobbling opponent before they recover takes away their time and space.
